MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 11

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

3. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 18

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 105

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
